motion: Gerrymandering is destroying the political center

dropped_turns.speaker: CON
dropped_turns.text: I grant that safe districts can reward sharper rhetoric. But voters still judge practical results and can organize across party lines, so gerrymandering cannot destroy the political center.

dropped_turns.speaker: PRO
dropped_turns.text: The weakest claim is that occasional organizing preserves power. A center that must overcome engineered districts merely to be heard has already lost representation, leverage, and the ability to shape politics.

turns.speaker: PRO
turns.text: This motion turns on political power, not whether moderate people still exist.
